title: Arkret Field Patch (ak.schema.patch.v1)
description: Canonical field-patch format embedded in event payloads (typically at payload.patch) for non-create updates. Its only protocol identifier is ak.schema.patch.v1. Grammar, parser responsibilities, redactable-field protection and reducer-managed-field protection are defined normatively in zh/models/event-and-patch.md §4.

propertyNames.$comment: Canonical machine projection of zh/models/event-and-patch.md §4.2.1. A path contains 1..16 dot-separated snake_case identifier segments, each 1..64 ASCII characters. Selector segments, quoted identifiers and numeric array indexes are not part of v1 and MUST be rejected with reason_code patch_path_invalid.

oneOf.$comment: Direct value form: equivalent to {"$op":"set","value":<value>}. Any JSON value EXCEPT a JSON object containing a $op discriminator may use this form.
Explicit op object form. $op is required; value is required for set/add/remove; value MUST be absent for unset.
